Class StandardProperties

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.style.StandardProperties
public final class StandardProperties extends Object
Central registry of all standard property definitions.

This class defines all properties understood by TamboUI, including their inheritance behavior. Properties marked as inheritable are automatically passed from parent to child elements if not explicitly set.

Inheritable properties:

  • color - foreground/text color
  • text-style - text modifiers (bold, italic, etc.)
  • border-type - border style (for nested containers)

Non-inheritable properties:

  • background, background-color - background color
  • padding - inner spacing
  • margin - outer spacing
  • flex, direction, spacing - layout properties
  • width, height - size constraints
  • text-align - text alignment

    • BACKGROUND

      public static final PropertyDefinition<Color> BACKGROUND
      The background property for background color. This property is NOT inheritable per CSS spec.

    • BACKGROUND_COLOR

      public static final PropertyDefinition<Color> BACKGROUND_COLOR
      The background-color property (alias for background). This property is NOT inheritable per CSS spec.

    • PADDING

      The padding property for inner spacing. This property is NOT inheritable. Default: Padding.NONE

    • MARGIN

      public static final PropertyDefinition<Margin> MARGIN
      The margin property for outer spacing. This property is NOT inheritable. Default: Margin.NONE

    • TEXT_ALIGN

      public static final PropertyDefinition<Alignment> TEXT_ALIGN
      The text-align property for text alignment. This property is NOT inheritable. Default: Alignment.LEFT

    • FLEX

      public static final PropertyDefinition<Flex> FLEX
      The flex property for flex layout mode. This property is NOT inheritable.

    • DIRECTION

      public static final PropertyDefinition<Direction> DIRECTION
      The direction property for layout direction. This property is NOT inheritable.

    • SPACING

      public static final PropertyDefinition<Integer> SPACING

    • WIDTH

      public static final PropertyDefinition<Constraint> WIDTH
      The width property for element width constraint. Supports: fill, fit, percentages (50%), fixed lengths (20), min/max, ratios (1/3). This property is NOT inheritable.

    • HEIGHT

      public static final PropertyDefinition<Constraint> HEIGHT
      The height property for height constraint. This property is NOT inheritable.

    • TEXT_OVERFLOW

      The text-overflow property for text wrapping/truncation behavior. This property is NOT inheritable. Default: Overflow.CLIP
